summary: The filing is a prospectus supplement (424B5) for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering by Lightwave Logic, Inc., increasing the available amount under a sales agreement with Roth Capital Partners to $51.4 million, leaving $49.3 million unsold. It discloses prior sales of 8.1M shares for ~$35M gross proceeds. There is no tender offer, acquisition, buyback, or special-situation event; it is a routine shelf takedown of common stock. The filing is purely a capital-raising prospectus supplement under an existing shelf registration, not triggering any special-situations category.
